{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter out rows with sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
valid_data = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Compute response rate by arm on valid data
treatment_response = valid_data[valid_data['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_response = valid_data[valid_data['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

# Compute treatment effect as difference in proportions (treatment - control)
treatment_effect = treatment_response - control_response

# Print results
print(f"Valid sample size: {len(valid_data)}")
print(f"Treatment response rate: {treatment_response:.4f}")
print(f"Control response rate: {control_response:.4f}")
print(f"Treatment effect (treatment - control): {treatment_effect:.4f}")"}
